title: Trainual Review (2026)
intro: Trainual is evaluated here as an SOP / employee training documentation platform — Trainual is an SOP knowledge base and employee training-path platform for documenting how work gets done, onboarding roles, and tracking completion. Published tiers are Core / Pro / Premium / Enterprise with contact/demo pricing (no public seat dollars). FAQ cites a $1,000 implementation fee and best fit for roughly 25–1000 employees. Higher tiers add AI-assisted docs, e-sign, and SSO. Pricing confidence low–medium. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s HR methodology (ease of use, hiring/workforce fit, workflow depth, integrations, mobile/frontline, analytics, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Trainual when documenting SOPs and running employee training paths is the primary job — and you can work through demo/quote pricing.
verdict: Choose Trainual when documenting SOPs and running employee training paths is the primary job — and you can work through demo/quote pricing. Compare LearnWorlds (marketing-primary LMS) for course commerce, Connecteam for frontline training-lite hubs, and Breezy if hiring/ATS is the actual job. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Trainual positions SOP templates, role charts, and training paths for operators who need process documentation without building a custom LMS. Score from first-party packaging, not lab testing.
Primary job is SOP knowledge base + employee training paths — strong sop-training cluster fit. Not scored as an ATS or time-clock peer.
Playbooks, subjects, tests, and completion tracking give solid training-path depth; e-sign and advanced governance land on higher tiers.
Slack/Google Workspace/Zapier-style support process distribution; not a full HRIS replacement.
Training content is consumable on mobile, but Trainual is not a deskless WFM/comms product — scored moderate for frontline readiness.
Completion and training reporting are marketed for managers; held at 7 vs deep L&D analytics suites.
FAQ best-fit 25–1000 employees plus Core→Enterprise ladder supports mid-market growth; micro teams may be underserved.
Opaque contact pricing plus a $1,000 implementation fee hurt transparency and entry value versus published ATS/WFM floors — capability is strong, price clarity is weak. Affiliate economics excluded.
AI-assisted documentation is published on higher tiers — useful for SOP drafting with plan gates rather than free unlimited AI.
